Findings triage round (triage seat Routine, 2026-08-07): **hold — verdict unchanged, but the measurement the hold was waiting on is now done.**

The 08-05 16:51Z grading held this with two reasons: (a) retirement is breaking and the v17 window closed with the #4938 batch, and (b) "判定前需先测 `plugin-hono-server` 是否实报这批能力(原单未测)". Reason (b) was the blocking unknown. It is measured now, against `origin/main` (`1eb13a0`).

## Measurement: the in-repo server implementation does not touch these shapes

```
git grep -iE "ServerCapabilit|ServerStatus|ServerEvent" origin/main -- packages/plugins/plugin-hono-server
  → zero hits
```

**Zero-hit reading falsified against a known-present neighbour** (SKILL notes 6 — a zero result is not a result until you prove the scanner was pointed at something real): the same package matches `@objectstack/spec` in `objectstack.config.ts`, `package.json`, and `src/adapter.ts:3`, so the path is right and the package genuinely imports from spec — it just never imports these four exports.

Repo-wide, the only things outside `system/http-server.zod.ts` that name them are **generated or documentation artifacts**, not implementations:

| site | kind |
|---|---|
| `content/docs/references/system/http-server.mdx:27-28`, `references/index.mdx:341` | generated reference pages |
| `packages/spec/api-surface/system.json:485-492` | generated API-surface baseline |
| `packages/spec/json-schema.manifest/system.json:222` | generated manifest |

So the original "zero consumers" claim holds at `1eb13a0`, and the strongest available counter-argument is now materially weaker: the "it's a contract for host implementers" defense would predict that *our own* reference host implementation consumes or reports it. It does not. What survives is only the unmeasurable version — an out-of-repo implementer we cannot see — which is the same argument that would protect any dead export forever.

⚠️ Deliberately **not** concluded: this measurement says `plugin-hono-server` does not report these capabilities. It does **not** by itself say the shapes should be retired. Whether a response/capability vocabulary with no implementer is dead weight or an unfinished conformance surface is exactly the judgment the retirement batch has to make — and the third disposition in the body ("降级为纯参考类型") remains open alongside retire and implement.

## Why still hold, not promote

Unchanged and still correct: retiring these exports is breaking, and the v17 retirement window closed with the #4938 batch. Nothing about this measurement creates urgency — there is no user-reachable harm, and the body itself notes missing the window costs nothing.

## Restart condition — same trigger, one less step

**Unchanged trigger:** the v18 train's retirement batch is opened.

**What changes:** that batch no longer has to start with a measurement. It can go straight to the three-way disposition, with this reading in hand:

- **retire under ADR-0049** — supported by zero in-repo consumers *including the reference host*; the route is `spec-property-retirement`, and note these are exports rather than authorable keys, so the ADR-0087 registry half differs from the #4938 batch's shape;
- **implement** — requires naming who reports `ServerStatus`/`ServerCapabilities` and adding an adapter conformance surface that consumes them; the absence of one in `plugin-hono-server` is the cost estimate;
- **demote to reference-only types** — the cheapest option and the one that best fits "response vocabulary for external hosts", if the batch decides the external-implementer argument is worth keeping.

⚠️ Re-measure at that point rather than trusting this comment: `1eb13a0` is a point-in-time reading and main moves ~18 merges a day. The command is in this comment precisely so re-running it is cheap.

本评论来自分诊座位 Routine(#5474 试点),不构成认领。 *(Triage-seat Routine; not a claim. English per the language policy effective with #6029, merged 23:55:44Z.)*

Findings triage round (triage seat Routine, 2026-08-07 11:47Z fire): **hold — verdict unchanged, but the retirement cost model changed under this issue ~4.5 h after the last grading, and it changed in the direction that argues against retiring.**

Re-read at `origin/main` `72847c5` (last grading was at `1eb13a0`).

## 1. The zero-consumer measurement still holds — for implementations

Re-run repo-wide, excluding the declaring file:

```
git grep -lE "ServerCapabilit|ServerStatus|ServerEventSchema|ServerEventType" origin/main -- 'packages/**' 'examples/**' 'apps/**'
```

Every hit is a **generated artifact or a test**, never an implementation: `api-surface/system.json`, `json-schema.manifest/system.json`, `authorable-surface/system.json`, `authorable-surface.base.json`, `src/system/http-server.test.ts`, `src/type-alias-convention.pin.test.ts`. `plugin-hono-server` still names none of the four (zero-hit falsified against the known-present neighbour as before — the package still imports `@objectstack/spec` in `objectstack.config.ts` / `package.json`).

## 2. What actually moved: PR #6072 (ADR-0122 phase 1, `7f713b6`, 05:19Z) touched this exact file

Two changes, both landing on the shapes this issue proposes to retire:

- **A new export was added to one of them.** `ServerCapabilitiesParsed` now sits next to `ServerCapabilities` (`http-server.zod.ts:290`), as part of phase 1's rule that every alias whose schema has two shapes declares its parsed name.
- **The other three are now pinned by a gate.** `type-alias-convention.pin.test.ts:1094-1096` asserts `z.input === z.infer` for `ServerEventType`, `ServerEventSchema` and `ServerStatusSchema` — and that file is not documentation. Its own header says so:

  > `scripts/check-spec-parsed-alias.mjs` reads THIS file to decide which bare aliases are allowed to have no `XParsed`. One artifact, two jobs…

So as of 05:19Z these four shapes have a **mechanical consumer they did not have when this issue was filed** — not a contract consumer, a gate consumer.

## 3. Why that is a reason to keep holding, not to promote

It cuts against the retire disposition twice:

- **Cost went up.** Retirement now also means removing three lines from the ADR-0122 phase-1 pin registry and satisfying `check-spec-parsed-alias.mjs`, plus deleting a freshly-added `XParsed` alias — i.e. touching a gate registry that landed hours ago, in a repo where that registry is designed to "only shrink, and shrink for the right reason".
- **It weakens the framing.** "Zero consumers" was the whole case. It is still true of implementations, but a reader now finds these names referenced by a live gate, and "dead export" is no longer the unqualified description it was on 08-05.

Nothing here creates urgency in the other direction either: still no user-reachable harm, still breaking to remove, and the v17 retirement window still closed with the #4938 batch. ⛔ Not promoted.

## 4. Restart condition — replacing the standing one, because it just proved unreliable

The previous condition was, in effect, "the next ADR-0049/0087 retirement batch takes it up". This round is the second consecutive one where a **batch touched this surface and did not take it up** (#6072 here; #5842 did the same to #5732's file yesterday). A trigger that depends on the person opening a batch happening to read this issue is the 「靠人记得」 mechanism this playbook rejects everywhere else.

Replacing it with two conditions that are checkable after the fact:

1. **Anyone edits these declarations themselves** — `http-server.zod.ts:203-236` (`ServerEventType` / `ServerEventSchema`), `:246-291` (`ServerCapabilities*`), `:301-339` (`ServerStatusSchema`). Verifiable with `git log -L`. Whoever is inside those lines can settle retire / implement / demote-to-reference at near-zero marginal cost.
2. **ADR-0122 phase 2 is scheduled** — phase 2 flips the bare names, which forces a decision on every alias in this file regardless of what anyone remembers. That is the natural forcing function, and it is externally visible rather than seat-memory.

⚠️ Unchanged and still deliberately not concluded: this seat has measured that nothing implements these shapes; it has **not** concluded they should be retired. Retire / implement a conformance surface / demote to pure reference types all remain open, and that judgment belongs to the retirement batch, not to a findings grading.
